steps: Read the five statements of the allowlist as they stand today (src/swfactory/doctor.py:45-52, deploy/islo/bootstrap.sh:23, deploy/islo/deploy.sh:12-13, docs/islo.md:10 and :52, docs/selfhost.md:146-150) and the existing gateway assertions in tests/test_doctor.py:166-175, so the new hosts are appended in the same order and shape everywhere.

In tests/test_doctor.py, add a module-level helper that extracts hosts from shell text by taking the substring between `ALLOW_HOSTS=(` and the next `)` and splitting on whitespace, and that raises (never returns an empty set) when the marker is absent or the parse yields nothing.

In tests/test_doctor.py, add the hermetic tests: exact-tuple pin of `doctor.GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS` (six existing entries unchanged and in place, plus `releases.astral.sh` and `release-assets.githubusercontent.com`); `gateway_fix('swfactory')` names both new hosts and keeps its `islo gateway create --name <profile> --default-action deny --internet-access true` prefix and `add-rule --host <host> --action allow` substring; doctor/bootstrap parity via the helper with a readable set diff on failure; the helper's loud-failure behaviour on missing/reformatted `ALLOW_HOSTS`; and coarse substring checks of the three prose sites. All reads go through `ROOT` / `Path.read_text` only — no subprocess, no network, no `islo`/`curl`.
Run `uv run --group dev pytest tests/test_doctor.py` and confirm the new tests fail for the right reason (missing hosts), not on an import or parse error.

Append `"releases.astral.sh"` and `"release-assets.githubusercontent.com"` to `GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS` in src/swfactory/doctor.py after `"astral.sh"`, keeping the tuple a flat frozen tuple of bare lowercase hostnames, and extend the comment above it to say these two are the `astral.sh` installer's redirect targets (301 to releases.astral.sh; GitHub-asset fallback to release-assets.githubusercontent.com).

Append the same two hosts, in the same order, to the `ALLOW_HOSTS=(...)` array on deploy/islo/bootstrap.sh:23, leaving it a single unquoted, comment-free line so the text parse stays exact and the existing idempotent `add-rule` loop picks them up unchanged.

Add both hosts to the `allow:` prerequisite comment for the orchestrator profile in deploy/islo/deploy.sh:12-13, alongside the existing `islo.dev` / `releases.islo.dev` entries, since that profile's setup script runs the same `astral.sh` uv installer.
Add both hosts to the two gateway host lists in docs/islo.md: the Agents row of the trust table (line 10) and the `gateway` row of the bootstrap table (line 52).

Rewrite docs/selfhost.md:147-150: drop the "unsettled whether `islo use --init minimal` executes the repo-root `islo.yaml` setup script" claim and state that it does execute it, that the script failed under the six-host allowlist with `curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 403`, that the cause is the `astral.sh` installer's redirects to `releases.astral.sh` and the GitHub-asset fallback to `release-assets.githubusercontent.com`, and record the observation (2026-09-27, islo CLI 0.53.1) — while preserving the surrounding unproven-evidence claims (no real-model run, no islo run, no self-authored merged PR).

Re-run `uv run --group dev pytest tests/test_doctor.py` (green, including the pre-existing `test_missing_gateway_profile`), then the full `uv run --group dev pytest` suite to confirm nothing else pinned the six-host list and the suite stays hermetic.

Confirm `git diff --name-only` lists only the six declared files and no entry of factory.toml's `protected` list (factory.toml, blueprints/, dags/, scripts/, .github/, agent.py, sandbox.py, stages.py, ...).
tests: R1: `test_gateway_allow_hosts_pin` asserts `"releases.astral.sh" in doctor.GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS`.
R2: same test asserts `"release-assets.githubusercontent.com" in doctor.GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS`.
R3: same test pins the full tuple by equality against the eight expected hosts, with the six existing entries first and unchanged (nothing removed, renamed, reordered, or given a scheme/path).
R4: `test_gateway_fix_names_uv_redirect_targets` asserts `releases.astral.sh` appears in `doctor.gateway_fix("swfactory")`.
R5: same test asserts `release-assets.githubusercontent.com` appears in `doctor.gateway_fix("swfactory")`.

R6: same test asserts the returned string starts with `islo gateway create --name swfactory --default-action deny --internet-access true` and contains `add-rule --host <host> --action allow`, and every entry of `GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS` appears in it (the existing `tests/test_doctor.py::test_missing_gateway_profile` must also still pass unmodified).
R7: `test_bootstrap_allow_hosts_match_doctor` asserts both new hosts are among the hosts parsed out of `deploy/islo/bootstrap.sh`'s `ALLOW_HOSTS` array.
R8: same test asserts `set(parsed) == set(doctor.GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS)`, reporting the symmetric difference in the assertion message so a drift names the missing/extra hosts.
R9: `test_prose_allowlists_name_new_hosts` asserts both hosts appear in the `allow:` comment block of `deploy/islo/deploy.sh` (coarse substring check on the file text).
R10: same test asserts both hosts appear in the Agents trust-table row and the `gateway` bootstrap-table row of `docs/islo.md` (both gateway host lists, checked per line).

R11: `test_selfhost_doc_settles_init_minimal` asserts `docs/selfhost.md` no longer contains "unsettled whether" / the `--init minimal` uncertainty wording, and does contain `curl: (22)`, `403`, `releases.astral.sh`, `release-assets.githubusercontent.com`, `2026-09-27` and `0.53.1`.
R12: same test asserts the adjacent unproven-evidence claims survive: the paragraph still names `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`/real model, `ISLO_API_KEY`/islo, and the un-merged self-authored pull request.

R13: `test_allow_hosts_parse_fails_loudly` feeds the helper shell text with no `ALLOW_HOSTS=` line, and text whose array is reformatted so no hosts can be extracted, and asserts it raises with a message naming the file/marker instead of returning an empty set (an empty parse can never become a vacuous pass).

R15: `test_new_allowlist_tests_are_hermetic` (and the tests above by construction) use only `ROOT`-relative `Path.read_text` and the imported `doctor` module — asserted by pinning that the helper takes text, not a command; the full `uv run --group dev pytest` suite still passes with no network, no `islo`, and no `curl`.

R14: repo-state check after the change — `git diff --name-only` lists exactly `src/swfactory/doctor.py`, `deploy/islo/bootstrap.sh`, `deploy/islo/deploy.sh`, `docs/islo.md`, `docs/selfhost.md`, `tests/test_doctor.py` and nothing from factory.toml's `protected` list.
risks: Vacuous parity: a regex that silently stops matching after a reformat would make R8 pass trivially. Bounded by R13 — the helper raises on an empty parse, and the parse rule (text between `ALLOW_HOSTS=(` and the next `)`, split on whitespace) is kept exact by leaving the array a single unquoted, comment-free line.
Drift the other way: someone adds a host to bootstrap.sh but not to the Python tuple. Bounded by the set-equality direction of R8 (extras fail too, with a named symmetric difference).

Brittle doc assertions: the prose checks (R9-R12) are substring-based and could fail on innocent rewording. Bounded by keeping them coarse — bare hostnames and the one retired phrase only, no whole-sentence or line-number pinning.

Hidden six-host assumptions elsewhere in the suite (for example a fixture asserting `rule_count == 6` or a length check). Bounded by running the whole suite, not just tests/test_doctor.py; `rule_count` in `tests/test_doctor.py:31` is canned islo output and is not a rule enumeration, and `_check_gateway` never enumerates rules, so no check outcome or the `11 checks` table shape changes.

Allowlist widening on a deny-by-default profile. Bounded to two narrow, vendor-owned redirect targets of tooling already allowed (`astral.sh`, `github.com`): no wildcard, no CDN-wide entry, `crates.io` still absent so factory.toml's Python-only test rationale stays true, and `release-assets.githubusercontent.com` serves release assets only (no API, no write, no token in the cell).

Scope creep into `config.SRT_DEFAULT_DOMAINS` (src/swfactory/config.py:28) or `deploy/islo/orchestrator/islo.yaml:12`, neither named by the intent. Bounded by the declared `files` list: both are left unchanged, and the residual inconsistency between `deploy.sh`'s comment and `orchestrator/islo.yaml`'s near-duplicate list is reported rather than silently fixed.

Self-hosting hazard — a cell widening its own cage. Bounded by R14: the change lives only in `doctor.py`, `deploy/**`, `docs/**` and `tests/**`; the confinement modules and the contract stay byte-identical, verified with `git diff --name-only`.
